reference.title: Equation of state and phase diagram of Fe–16Si alloy as a candidate component of Earth’s core

methods.notes: Exact Fischer 2012 B2 KBr thermal calibration is not bundled; do not substitute the Dewaele 2012 KBr record. KBr is colder than the sample; the marker temperature requires the source gradient correction.

recalculation.notes: Raw KBr lattice parameters are retained for all compressed observations. Only corrected sample temperatures are tabulated; marker temperatures would require reconstruction of the original surface-temperature/gradient procedure, not a second sample correction. Secondary ruby/neon raw readings are not tabulated.

pressure_calibration.notes: KBr is the principal pressure standard for the selected heated B2 observations. Published source pressures are retained; no recalculation is performed.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.
qualifications: This comparison concerns the stored independent Peritheos refit, not recovery of the original publication's coefficients or author workflow.

Stored Peritheos refit reproduction using all 114 single-phase B2 rows and physical n=2 per FeSi formula. Parity compares against independently fitted Peritheos coefficients, not Fischer's published B2 parameters, which remain withheld. Unweighted pressure residuals; V0, K0-prime and theta0 are conditional fixed assumptions. Full covariance, weighting/reference sensitivities and pressure-block holdouts are in the [Fischer audit](literature-reproductions/fischer-2014-fesi.md). No validated core extrapolation.

fit.solver_message: Both `ftol` and `xtol` termination conditions are satisfied.

locations: Official Table S2, all 114 phase=B2 observations
primary_source_check.finding: Source observations, equation, physical normalization and fixed assumptions verified; executable coefficients and joint covariance are independent Peritheos refits. Published B2 parameters remain withheld.

primary_data_check.finding: All 180 source observations retained; exact phase selection uses all 114 single-phase B2 rows and excludes B20 and B20+B2. All reported marker/lattice/P/T uncertainties are preserved.

scientific_validation.note: Source observations, equation, physical normalization and fixed assumptions verified; executable coefficients and joint covariance are independent Peritheos refits. Published B2 parameters remain withheld.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Table 2/S6 fixed assumptions; Official Table S2, all 114 phase=B2 observations; scripts/refit_fischer_2014_b2.py and docs/data/fischer-2014-b2-refits.json.
parameter_provenance.equation: Standard BM3 or Vinet plus reference-subtracted Debye thermal pressure, gamma=gamma0*(V/V0)^q and integrated-Gruneisen theta law; physical n=2 per FeSi formula.
parameter_provenance.V0: Fischer (2014) Table 2: adopted 6.414 cm3/mol atoms, held fixed; converted with 2/.602214076 to angstrom^3/B2 cell.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Fischer (2014) Table 2/S6: adopted 4.17, held fixed as a conditional fit assumption.
parameter_provenance.theta0: Fischer (2014) Table 2/S6: 417 K adopted from iron, held fixed.
parameter_provenance.gamma0: Independent fit with physical thermal normalization; no claim this is an authoritative correction to the published gamma0.
parameter_provenance.q: Independent fit; strongly correlated with K0 and gamma0.
parameter_provenance.uncertainties: Conditional local 1-sigma errors: covariance=(J.T J)^-1*SSE/(114-3). Observations are treated as independent with equal residual variance. These errors omit fixed-input uncertainty, run correlations, calibrant systematics and model discrepancy. Sensitivity cases are not a probability distribution.

software.name: Peritheos independent audit using SciPy least_squares

fit_provenance.covariance_scaling: SSE/(114-3), conditional local 1-sigma; fixed-input and calibration uncertainties excluded
fit_provenance.assumptions: V0=6.414 cm3/mol atoms, K0-prime=4.17 and theta0=417 K are inherited fixed choices, not newly measured quantities. Their uncertainty is absent from the conditional covariance. No source fitting weights or P-T covariance are assumed recovered.
fit_provenance.sensitivity: Evidence includes multistart, pressure-sigma-only weights, three pressure-block holdouts, V0=6.435, and explicitly analyst-selected theta0 and K0-prime stress tests. These are not alternative accepted fits or confidence intervals.

superseded_record_text.label: Peritheos BM3 + MGD refit of Fischer et al. (2014) B2 FeSi data
superseded_record_text.notes: Independent Peritheos refit of source observations, not Fischer's published B2 coefficients and not an established source correction. Physical n=2 per FeSi formula and conventional-cell volume are used consistently. Parameter errors are conditional local 1-sigma estimates for equal, independent pressure residual variance; the full joint covariance is stored. K0-prime and reference choices strongly affect gamma0, so formal errors are not total material-property uncertainty. Use within the measured range; no validated core extrapolation. BM3 is the default only within this explicitly refit-only material; no published default is replaced.
